title: Pedantic Schema: mandatory first-class machine-executable contracts
owner: Existing IDP schema-conformance and intent-compile owners; Argon protocol verifier for federated transport
terminology: Pedantic Schema is this estate's proposed stronger doctrine; it is not asserted to be a published industry standard or an existing product.
principle: Every consequential boundary uses a named versioned machine-validatable schema; no implicit defaults, loose unknown fields, silent coercion, forgotten migrations or semantic claims disguised as structural validity. Strict for new or migrated interfaces; measured ratchet for legacy interfaces. Schema authority cannot be supplied by the payload under evaluation.

requirements.rule: Central schema identity and registry: schema_id, semantic version, canonical digest, owner, producer, consumer, effect class, source policy SHA, expiry/deprecation and migrations. No second schema compiler.
requirements.falsifier: Missing authority, unversioned payload, schema drift or duplicate schema owner is rejected/flagged

requirements.rule: At DECODE enforce committed schema where supported; constrain model output and revalidate final value against exact digest; no model-only assertion.
requirements.falsifier: Decoded JSON with unknown/missing fields fails independent validation

requirements.rule: At EXECUTION door validate declared args, required, type, ranges, formats, enum, unknown fields, nested structures; never silently coerce bad input or interpolate absent values.
requirements.falsifier: Undeclared argument, 'abc' for integer, missing required value or raw shell injection refuses before effect

requirements.rule: At REPAIR boundary expose original-invalid result, failed field, attempt, transformed content and validated final digest; distinguish first-pass success, repaired and failed.
requirements.falsifier: Repaired output cannot be counted as pristine/first-pass in Optimus

requirements.rule: No silent schema evolution: check consumer compatibility, back/forward contract tests, version pinning and explicit migration/rollback on published protocol boundaries.
requirements.falsifier: Producer adds field that strict consumer rejects; CI detects before consumer deploy

requirements.rule: Canonical validators execute from trusted base in the authorised effect door; packet cannot modify validator, source schema or error policy used to judge itself.
requirements.falsifier: Schema swap and validator injection cannot grant permission

requirements.rule: All required execution and evidence envelopes include identity, instruction_id, effect scope, causal parent, source/policy/schema digests, timestamp, tri-state result, proof link and idempotency key. Private payloads remain encrypted/redacted.
requirements.falsifier: Missing source or provenance never yields VERIFIED_YIELD

requirements.rule: Conformance coverage inventory enumerates four existing payload families (intent call, receipt/envelope, doc/claim, catalog/graph) and producer-consumer cross-repo boundaries; apply one canonical schema per payload type.
requirements.falsifier: A new producer can neither claim compatible nor pass gate with undocumented schema

requirements.rule: Rollout: publish baseline of old violations; new violations refused now; fix existing by deterministic migration; turn strict only for clean cohorts with positive/negative canary and automated rollback of new scope if false denial.
requirements.falsifier: Old known violations do not freeze all unrelated legitimate work

requirements.rule: Every schema gate records PASS/FAIL/BLIND including source/version and failing JSON pointer, latency, coverage and mutation test witness; no silent skip.
requirements.falsifier: Disabled validator or empty fixture cannot produce PASS

requirements.rule: For semantic quality (correct business meaning, entailment, safety), supply bounded schema-valid proposals but require independent factual verifier; schema correctness is necessary not sufficient.
requirements.falsifier: Well-formed fabricated financial/domain evidence never certifies verified truth

acceptance: B1 decoder, B2 door, B3 repair tests anchored to ADR 0042
Actual baseline comparison, strict clean canary and no false denial spike
Cross-runtime schema/policy versions tracked and distributed from existing context compiler
Mutation tests that remove validation or swap schema fail
Live protocol ingress and effect egress show tri-state receipts
explicit_non_goals: No new Pydantic/BAML registry as parallel authority
No schema format that includes payments/secrets in logs
No model treating valid syntax as verified truth
reference_standard: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for JSON payloads; fit to existing protocols and validators; formal syntax does not imply legal or epistemic correctness
